identity_check: Confirmed as Edmund s.r.o. (edmundai.com, also styled 'Edmund AI'), the Czech start-up founded in 2023 by Jakub Szlaur (CEO), Benjamin Przeczek (COO) and Miroslav Marek (CSO) that sells an 'AI debugging platform for industrial maintenance'. The domain was confirmed through Tech.eu's link and Vestbee's mention of edmundai.com; the company site and careers page, Tech.eu, TechFundingNews, Vestbee, inforcapital (the lead), AIN, The AI Insider and CzechCrunch (cc.cz) all describe the same founders, product (agents reading PLC projects, schematics, documentation, maintenance logs and live machine data to find fault root causes) and investors (Czech Founders VC, Lighthouse Ventures, Tensor Ventures, FORWARD.one, U2V). The domain is not 'edmund.com' or similar; the name is common, and no other Edmund business is linked. The lead and several articles say Prague; the company's own footer and careers page put the HQ in Ostrava with a Prague office (see conflicts). Not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; found through a discovery search. Category set to direct: its agents serve maintenance technicians and engineers on the shop floor, diagnosing machine stoppages down to PLC code, schematics and maintenance history and logging repairs by voice. That is Utopian Autonomy's maintenance / process-stability function for plant staff. Differences: maintenance and automation only (no procurement, RFQ / BOM or drawing agents), a chat / voice web interface rather than WhatsApp, and European (Czech, German-owned and multinational) plants rather than Indian SMEs.

company.name: Edmund
company.description: Ostrava-based start-up (Edmund s.r.o.) whose AI agents diagnose machine faults for maintenance teams by reading PLC code, schematics, manuals, alarms, maintenance logs and live machine data.

layer_detail: Maintenance and automation troubleshooting on the shop floor: a PLC agent (Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Allen-Bradley, Omron; anything compiling to IEC 61131-3; Codesys, Beckhoff, Schneider, WAGO 'coming soon'), robotics intelligence (ABB RAPID; FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa coming), an ePLAN schematics agent, an SQL / MES agent, a document agent, maintenance journals (technicians dictate notes at the machine) and data-health checks. Root-cause analysis with step-by-step repair guidance via an 'Ask Edmund' chat and voice. Hosting: cloud, hybrid, on-premises or upload-only (AWS EU / US). Distribution partly through machine builders (CzechCrunch, 2024).
product_summary: An AI debugging platform for industrial maintenance: agents ingest a line's PLC programs, robot code, electrical schematics, manuals, alarms, MES data and maintenance journals, then trace a stoppage to its root cause and give technicians step-by-step fixes through chat or voice, logging repairs back into the maintenance record.

open_items: Total raised: about €3.04M by sum of the three rounds found (€40K + €500K + €2.5M); no page states a total.

The €40K Czech Founders VC cheque (CzechCrunch, 2024-08-07) is recorded as a separate pre-seed / validation round; Czech Founders VC then joined the €500K pre-seed. A Techleap feed item ('edmund-ai-secures-40k-investment') seen in search was not opened.

The homepage footer also credits Czech public funding (Technological Incubation programme via CzechInvest, NextGenerationEU / National Recovery Plan); grant amount not stated, not recorded as a round.
Pre-seed: The AI Insider dated 2025-02-16 and AIN 2025-02-12; AIN date used. A search result showed startupintros listing the pre-seed as $580K (likely conversion); not opened.
